recipes.name: Pepperoni Pizza Casserole
ingredients_raw: 1 (16 ounce) jar spaghetti sauce, or as needed
1 (8 ounce) package sliced pepperoni, coarsely chopped
1 (2.25 ounce) can sliced black olives, drained

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Cook ground beef in a skillet over medium heat until no longer pink, breaking into crumbles as it cooks, about 10 minutes.
Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rapid boil. Cook egg noodles at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes; drain.

Combine beef, noodles, 1/2 mozzarella cheese, spaghetti sauce, pepperoni, mushrooms, and black olives in a large bowl; transfer to a 9x13-inch baking dish. Top with remaining 1/2 mozzarella cheese. Cover the dish with aluminum foil.
Bake in the preheated oven until casserole is bubbling, 30 to 45 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Pepperoni Pizza Casserole
raw_recipe.description: This cheesy pepperoni pizza casserole recipe uses beef, mushrooms, olives, pepperoni, and lots of mozzarella cheese yielding all the flavors of a pizza.

review.reviewBody: Good taste and easy to make. However, this recipe does not mention what to do with the ground beef - figured I would just mix in the ground beef with the rest of the ingredients.

I basically used a large bag of egg white noodles. They are so much faster to cook. I added cottage cheese and sausage instead of hamburger and pepperoni the thick kind. I added minced red and yellow peppers 2 to be exact . Minced sweet onion etc. Very versatile recipe. I love pizza and I never thought of turning it into a casserole. So thanks for the inspiration. You can add any pizza toppings. After my sausage was done I started adding toppings. It turned out great. I didn't have any mozzarella cheese so I just used cheddar . Such a wonderful recipe. Thanks again.

I gotta say, it doesn't get much easier than this! I do however recommend swapping step 2 and 3 around. That way your pasta is done first (no washing the pan) and draining while your beef cooks. I also recommend using mini pepperoni so no chopping is required. It looks better in the finished dish as well. Can't help but wonder if Italian sausage might be better than beef in this? Not sure but I will sub it next time. Overall good casserole and simple.

I use ground Italian sausage instead of ground beef, and include chopped onion and green pepper. It's a hit at tailgate parties; I prepare the casserole at home, then heat it in individual mini-loaf bread pans on my table top gas grill which I've converted into an oven. Everybody gets their own mini loaf...no need to spoon it out.

Quite tasty. Family members request this be made again. I doubled the recipe. I added 1 pkg of Italian seasoning to the sauce (jar of marinara & 1 can tomato sauce) before mixing with noodles. I used ground turkey, turkey pepperoni , black olives, red onion, mushrooms, & various cheeses: mozzarella, colby jack, parmesan, & a pizza blend.
Everyone loved it. I left out the mushrooms. I saved a few pepperonis to lay on top. Next time I will try Italian sausage.
Excellent!! I made a few adjustments though... used ground sausage instead of beef, fresh mushrooms instead of canned mushrooms, alfredo sauce instead of spaghetti sauce, and NO olives.

This recipe is quick and easy and is an all-around favorite. Even my picky eater was quick to eat this up. One of the few items that I can make from scratch and have NO leftovers. I changed nothing in the recipe but I'm thinking the next time I make this I just might use rotini or another pasta that can catch the sauce. Also next time I am going to double the recipe LOL.

20 ounces of cheese?! Yikes! I did 10oz and that was just right. My modified version is 5 stars, this version at 20oz is 4 stars. Left out the black olives and onions. Meant to add in chopped bell peppers but forgot. Next time will add them. My 10yr old doesn't usually like pepperoni but I cut them into 1/4's and she ate them without issue. I always use turkey pepperoni and ground turkey to stay healthier.
Delicious. I made it with leftover spaghetti, added green olives, sautéed onions, and used Italian sausage. I also used a larger can of sauce because it seemed dry at first.
Super easy! We subbed Italian sausage for hamburger and green olives for black plus used a mix of mozzarella and pizza cheese- we also only did mushrooms on half.
This recipe satisfied all 5 of us. That is quite a feat! My daughter is taking this to college to make for her roommates. That's high praise!
Quick and easy to follow recipe. Used ground turkey instead of beef. I left the olives and mushrooms out. I used spaghetti. Had to add seasoning for flavor. Will make again!
I substituted in 2 cans of DonPepino pizza sauce. Instead of ground beef I used hot Italian sausage. This was so delicious!
One of my favorites, and every time I make it for company, they ask me for the recipe.
